facts.title: winter squash pancakes with crispy sage and brown butter
ingredients: 1 cup (8 to 8 1/4 ounces) roasted and mashed winter squash
1/3 cup (80 grams) yogurt or sour cream
1/2 cup (about 30 grams) finely grated gruyere, comte or parmesan
3/4 teaspoon fine sea or table salt
A few grinds of black pepper
Butter or olive oil for frying pan
A pinch or two of salt
facts.yield_text: 12 pancakes, can serve 3 as a main or 4 to 6 as a side
facts.author: Deb Perelman
